description: This file defines a React component for a note detail page, including fetching, editing, and deleting notes via API calls, and rendering UI elements for note display and user interactions.

methods.name: NoteDetailPage({ params })
methods.description: Main React component for displaying, editing, and deleting a note based on URL parameters.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles saving changes to a note, updates state, and closes the edit modal.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes the current note via API call and redirects to the notes list.
